rule.event: point-in-time SEC 8-K Item 2.02 acceptance mapped to first session close after acceptance
rule.earnings_announcement_return: asset close-to-close reaction minus SPY close-to-close reaction over the same prior-session to reaction-session window
rule.entry: next asset session open after the reaction session
rule.overlapping_events: each event is an independent statistical observation in this gate

economics.dividends: omitted where raw sources are used; conservative for long holdings

sequencing: Only a pass may proceed to fixed-capital concurrent portfolio construction, SQ translation, and incremental portfolio admission.
